Dear Noor Fatima, 💗

Happy Birthday to the girl who makes my world feel a little more beautiful. You bring a special kind of happiness into my life, and I feel lucky to have you by my side. I hope you always know how loved and precious you are to me. 💗

It’s the little things about you that mean so much to me—your smile, our conversations, and the moments we share. I wish I could make every day feel as special as you make mine. May this year bring you endless happiness, beautiful surprises, and everything your heart wishes for. ✨

Never stop being the lovely person you are. I’ll always be cheering for your dreams, celebrating your smiles, and wishing the very best for you. I hope this birthday is just the beginning of a year filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. ❤️

You will always be someone special to me. 💗

Yours, with all my love 💗
